name: Gildo Ricci, 69, of Rockville, Maryland (silhouette only)
depiction: Gildo Ricci, 69, a Peruvian citizen and US permanent resident living in Rockville, Maryland, convicted by a federal jury in Alexandria (January 2025) of possession with intent to distribute cocaine found in cakes and soup mix he carried into Dulles from Bogota (April 2024). Named because he was convicted and is named by the US Attorney's Office and the press. Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette, standing at an inspection table or in a dock: no face, no features, no national costume or flag. NOT A LIKENESS.
